newsitem.title: TUNISIA: TUNIS BOURSE INDEX CLOSES SLIGHTLY DOWN.
newsitem.headline: TUNIS BOURSE INDEX CLOSES SLIGHTLY DOWN.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Wednesday closed slightly down by 0.08 percent, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 595.65 percent from 596.12 on Tuesday.
Trade volume was 1.8 million dinars against 1.61 million dinars.
BIAT bank was down 2.81 dinars to 60.780 dinars. Retail stores MONOPRIX was up 1.04 dinar to 35.76 dinars. BNDT bank up 0.85 dinar to 29.5 dinars. ($=0.98 dinar)
